title: Advanced Mega Drive Hardware Technique Coverage Catalog
purpose: Mapear a nomenclatura humana fornecida para IDs canonicos, status reais e regras de aplicacao sem confundir curadoria com dominio pratico.

mastery_truth.statement: Cobertura registrada nao significa dominio. MESTRE exige ROM, BlastEm, budget, documentacao sincronizada e aprovacao humana.

claims_rejected.claim: SGDK C optimizations reduce overhead by up to 80 percent
claims_rejected.reason: No measured canonical benchmark or approved project evidence.

claims_rejected.claim: DMA outside VBlank is a production-safe default
claims_rejected.reason: Conflicts with current canonical safety rule; HBlank/active-display DMA remains laboratory-only.

claims_rejected.claim: Mega Drive provides real Mode 7 or alpha blending
claims_rejected.reason: Hardware does not provide those features; only honest approximations are registered.

claims_rejected.claim: Direct vector patching, register pinning, SMC or O3 are automatic optimizations
claims_rejected.reason: They are timing/ABI/toolchain-sensitive experiments requiring isolated proof and fallback.

primary_local_sources.role: Primary SGDK 2.11 DMA API and VBlank queue semantics
Primary SGDK system and interrupt API
